title: Successor resolution follow-ups: restored-parent execution fallback, many-to-one consolidation, done-refusal reason, typed verbose patch
outcome: Successor resolution follow-ups: restored-parent execution fallback, many-to-one consolidation, done-refusal reason, typed verbose patch
acceptance: A restored Open parent with no run yet computes required_child_successor from its latest run execution when present and from the active root execution only when absent (never active-first); a regression test restores P with Open C and S, finishes S, supersedes C, and asserts show, the parent's required_owed group, and done agree before and after P's first claim

The verbose ls JSON child_resolution patch goes through a typed verbs-only wrapper instead of index-addressed serde_json::Value mutation; ambient and core serialization keep serde(skip) on required_child_successor

Two required children superseded by the same completed required sibling both resolve through that one successor seal with two distinct resolved_by_successor entries; one test and one docs sentence state the audited consolidation
done's refusal row for an owed-with-successor required child carries the same one-line successor reason and lifecycle as show, sharing the ShowChildSuccessor rendering

completion.summary: Delivered restored-parent generation fallback, typed verbose receipts, explicit many-to-one consolidation coverage, and same-cut successor explanations in done refusals; reviewed, verified, and landed.
